-- Bone before BasePart (Bone IS-A BasePart but .Position is bind pose, not live).
local function getTargetPosition(target)
	if not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
	if target:IsA("Bone") then return target.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.Position end
	if target:IsA("Attachment") then return target.WorldPosition end
	if target:IsA("Camera") then return target.CFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(target.GetPivot, target); if ok and cf then return cf.Position end end
	return nil
end

-- A Container's hold on this particle's look (its carried record, pData._drive): the
-- record's brightness multiplies, its colour acts by the Container's Color Mode.
local function drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
	local drive = pData._drive
	if not drive then
		return color, brightness
	end
	if drive.look then
		color = ContainerColors.driven(pData, color, drive)
	end
	return color, brightness * drive.brightness
end

return function(Particle)

-- Part update: position (4 branches), rotation, size, color/transparency, flipbook.
-- Branches: Inverted reads precomputed CFrames; VelocityVectored needs full per-step iteration;
-- fast paths skip ahead with no accel/drag.
function Particle:UpdatePart(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: ts sampled at real_i (not effective i) so it progresses
	-- monotonically through keypoints regardless of effective-time direction. ts(0)<0 →
	-- particle starts at end of life and rewinds; ts(0)>=0 → starts forward.
	-- SetTimescale override (Lifecycle.luau) wins over the graph for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	-- Carried by a Container: its Timescale graph runs this particle's time too.
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	-- Particle dies when effective sits at a boundary AND the graph has finished playing.
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	-- OnHit Collision=Stop (or auto-settle freeze): skip motion/step work, age normally.
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end

	-- Nested-Model scale: fold the parent Model's current scale into nested-particle motion.
	-- motionFactor scales the spatial delta (Speed/Accel/PosOffset) when ScaleMotion; rotFactor
	-- scales RotSpeed (via rotDamp) when ScaleRotation; sizeFactor scales Size. 1 when not nested.
	local sizeFactor, motionFactor, rotFactor = 1, 1, 1
	if pData.ParentScale then
		sizeFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		motionFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "motion")
		rotFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "rotation")
	end
	-- A Container's Scale graph sizes the mesh; its motion is its own.
	if drive then sizeFactor = sizeFactor * drive.scale end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin (deg/sec) into _spinAccum (degrees); composes with both rotation modes.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			-- parentCF_now / dirInfo hoisted outside the loop; final CFrame written once at batch end.
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			local localCF = pData.LocalCF
			local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ
			local baseDir = pData.BaseDirection
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local targetVel = pData.TargetVel
			-- Seed simPos from live VisualPart.Position (overlays moved CFrame since CurrentPosition write).
			local simPos = pData.VisualPart.Position
			local rotMode = pData.RotMode
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			local lastWorldCF, lastLocalWorldCF
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = baseDir * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- Target accel: Euler integration; reads simPos for mid-substep tracking.
				if pData.HasTargetAccel then
					local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
					if tPos then
						local toTarget = tPos - simPos
						local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
						if dist > 1e-4 then
							local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
							if mag and mag ~= 0 then
								targetVel = targetVel + toTarget * (mag * perStepDT / dist)
								displacement = displacement + targetVel * perStepDT
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping sums integrate to the absolute-offset
				-- change. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the velocity; a Local-mode offset is
				-- already link-local and added as-is (else a spinning Weld precesses it).
				local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS)
				local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, displacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
				localCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * localCF

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
				local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
				local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
				if rotMode == "Speed" then
					accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX + sx, accRotY + sy, accRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				lastWorldCF = (parentCF_now * localCF) * rotationCFrame
				lastLocalWorldCF = localCF * rotationCFrame
				simPos = lastWorldCF.Position

				local rotatedCF = lastWorldCF * pData.SpreadRotation
				baseDir = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ = accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ
			pData.BaseDirection = baseDir
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.TargetVel = targetVel
			pData.CurrentPosition = simPos
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			if lastWorldCF then
				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = lastWorldCF
				pData._localWorldCF = lastLocalWorldCF
			end

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity (mid-frame si).
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT2 = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT2 / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT2
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life position graphs. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the
			-- world velocity; a Local-mode offset is already link-local and added as-is so a
			-- spinning Weld lets the radius shrink instead of precessing the offset.
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				-- Drag fallback: per-step loop.
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity sample.
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffset over-life graphs. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the velocity; a Local-mode
			-- offset is link-local and added as-is (no precession on a spinning Weld).
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SIZE  -  gated by pData.SkipSize (set via payload.SetSkipSize).
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		if not pData.SkipSize then
			local sizex = pData._staticSizeX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX)
			local sizey = pData._staticSizeY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY)
			local sizez = pData._staticSizeZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ)

			-- Nested-Model scale on Size (always-on; independent of ScaleMotion). sizeFactor
			-- hoisted once at function top via Constants.getParentScaleFactor.
			if sizeFactor ~= 1 then
				sizex = sizex * sizeFactor
				sizey = sizey * sizeFactor
				sizez = sizez * sizeFactor
			end

			if pData.SpecialMesh then
				pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Size = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			end
		end

		-- VISUAL
		local transparency = pData._staticTransparency or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)

		if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
			-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
			-- EmissiveTint write pcall-guarded for older Studio builds without the property.
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(color.R * brightness, color.G * brightness, color.B * brightness) end)
			end
		elseif pData.HasDecal and not pData.DecalLayersMode then
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.Decal.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * brightness, color.G * 255 * brightness, color.B * 255 * brightness) end
		else
			-- Mesh: Brightness scales the mesh colour in decal-layers mode; legacy plain meshes ignore it.
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			local brightness = 1
			if pData.DecalLayersMode then
				brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			end
			color, brightness = drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * brightness, color.G * 255 * brightness, color.B * 255 * brightness) end
			if pData.Layers then DecalLayersMod.write(pData, steppedI) end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateAttachment Mixin  -  per-frame update for Attachment particles, split from Update.luau
	for the 500-line cap. Composes in the visual parent's space (LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame).
	Hot-path zero-allocation contract: no CFrame/Vector3/table creation in step loops.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local UpdateCommon = require(script.Parent.UpdateCommon)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local _posOffsetFrameDelta = UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta
local _composeLocalDelta = UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta

return function(Particle)

-- Attachment update: parent-local motion. No Size graph (Attachments drive child instances).
function Particle:UpdateAttachment(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end

	-- Nested-Model scale (see UpdatePart): motionFactor scales the spatial delta, rotFactor
	-- scales RotSpeed via rotDamp, sizeFactor scales Size. 1 when not nested.
	local sizeFactor, motionFactor, rotFactor = 1, 1, 1
	if pData.ParentScale then
		sizeFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		motionFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "motion")
		rotFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "rotation")
	end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)
	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- actualParent-local link CFrame; identity when no link.
		local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame(pData)

		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the world velocity into
				-- link-local; a Local-mode offset is already link-local and added as-is.
				local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS)
				local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, displacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				-- Rotation
				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart.CFrame * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local stepDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateBeam Mixin  -  per-frame update for Beam particles (no spatial motion).
	GraphBlender lerps between authored Transparency/Color states; pair-index cached for O(1) search.
	Animate-loop reset must clear _lastTransIdx/_lastColorIdx (init.luau handles this).
	TextureSpeed uses integral-based offset (engine's rate-accumulator is FPS-dependent).
	ParentScale multiplies Width/CurveSize/TextureLength/Segments by nested-Model scale factor.
	Carried by a Container (pData._drive, set by EmitBeam through Container/Lines.carry): the
	Container's Timescale runs this beam's clock, and Lines.driveBeam, LAST in the update, puts
	the rest of what it asks on top of what the beam's own graphs wrote this frame.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerLines = require(script.Parent.Container.Lines)
-- Transition eases read at fixed x; a shared empty seed keeps the hot loop allocation-free.
local EMPTY_SEED = {}
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Beam-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes Width0/1, Color, Transparency from authored graphs + GraphBlender states.
-- Returns true when the particle has died.
function Particle:UpdateBeam(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	-- Continuous-time, FPS-independent.
	local t = i

	local transStates = pData.TransStates
	local colorStates = pData.ColorStates

	-- Transparency blender
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		if transStates and #transStates >= 2 then
			local lastTrans = pData._lastTransIdx or 1
			-- Reverse-Timescale support: rescan from start when t dropped below cached pair's lower bound.
			if t < transStates[lastTrans].Time then lastTrans = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #transStates - 1
			for idx = lastTrans, #transStates - 1 do
				if t >= transStates[idx].Time and t <= transStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastTransIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = transStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = transStates[pairIdx + 1] or transStates[#transStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
			local mergedTimes = pData.TransMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif transStates and #transStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- Color blender
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		if colorStates and #colorStates >= 2 then
			local lastColor = pData._lastColorIdx or 1
			if t < colorStates[lastColor].Time then lastColor = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #colorStates - 1
			for idx = lastColor, #colorStates - 1 do
				if t >= colorStates[idx].Time and t <= colorStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastColorIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = colorStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = colorStates[pairIdx + 1] or colorStates[#colorStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
			local mergedTimes = pData.ColorMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif colorStates and #colorStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Color = colorStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- TextureSpeed: integral-based offset for FPS independence.
	local tsAnim = pData.AnimatedProps.TextureSpeed
	if tsAnim then
		local integral = GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(t, tsAnim.Sequence, tsAnim.Seed)
		pData.VisualPart:SetTextureOffset((-integral * pData.LifeTime) % 1)
	end

	-- Other animated beam properties (Width0, Width1, CurveSize, etc.)
	for name, animData in pairs(pData.AnimatedProps) do
		if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
			local val = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, animData.Sequence, animData.Seed)
			if name == "Segments" then val = math.max(20, math.round(val)) end
			pData.VisualPart[name] = val
		end
	end

	-- Parent model scale (nested beams): the chain reads each owner's published _ownScale.
	if pData.ParentScale then
		local ps = pData.ParentScale
		local pFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(ps, currentTime, GraphMod)
		local vb = pData.VisualPart
		local ap = pData.AnimatedProps
		vb.Width0 = (ap.Width0 and vb.Width0 or pData._baseWidth0) * pFactor
		vb.Width1 = (ap.Width1 and vb.Width1 or pData._baseWidth1) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize0 = (ap.CurveSize0 and vb.CurveSize0 or pData._baseCurveSize0) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize1 = (ap.CurveSize1 and vb.CurveSize1 or pData._baseCurveSize1) * pFactor
		-- TextureLength multiplies (preserves tile count as beam scales) when Model's
		-- ScaleTextureLength attribute is true (default). False leaves authored value
		-- so tiles repeat more densely as beam grows.
		if ps.ScaleTextureLength ~= false then
			vb.TextureLength = (ap.TextureLength and vb.TextureLength or pData._baseTextureLength) * pFactor
		end
		vb.Segments = math.max(20, math.round((ap.Segments and vb.Segments or pData._baseSegments) * pFactor))
	end

	if drive then ContainerLines.driveBeam(pData) end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	UpdateCommon  -  per-frame displacement helpers shared by the Part and Attachment update mixins
	(Update.luau, UpdateAttachment.luau). UpdateModel keeps its own variant.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Difference-based: sample absolute offset at t_norm in the DisplacementMode
-- frame, subtract _prevWorldOff. LocalCF accumulator integrates correctly.
-- Three frames mirror DirMode (Speed direction):
--   Global     = world axes (no rotation applied)
--   Local      = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame; per-particle RotXYZ
--                rotates the path → fans / scatter / convergence patterns)
--   RigidLocal = SpawnEmitterRotation (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ;
--                path follows emitter orientation but not particle tumble)
-- Returns (delta, isLinkLocal). isLinkLocal is true when the offset is already in
-- link-local space (Local mode under a useVOS link) and so must NOT be VOS'd again —
-- see _composeLocalDelta. Otherwise the delta is in world/emitter space like before.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI, useVOS)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero, false end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own telescoping accumulator (_prevTurbOff): OnHit Bounce
	-- mirrors re-baseline only _prevWorldOff, and noise never mirrors.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	-- Local mode's SpawnRotation is captured link-local under a link, so the delta is
	-- already link-local. Flag it so the apply site skips the second VOS that would
	-- precess it around a spinning Weld instead of letting the radius shrink.
	local isLinkLocal = useVOS and (pData.DisplacementMode or "Global") == "Local"
	return delta, isLinkLocal
end

-- Stack a frame's displacement into a link-local LocalCF accumulator. The world-built
-- velocity is VOS'd into link-local when welded; a link-local PosOffset is added as-is.
-- motionFactor scales the whole spatial delta (Speed + Accel + PosOffset) by the parent
-- Model's scale for nested particles (1 otherwise) — applied to the sum so it stays coherent.
local function _composeLocalDelta(parentCF, useVOS, velWorld, posDelta, posIsLinkLocal, motionFactor)
	if not useVOS then return (velWorld + posDelta) * motionFactor end
	local velLocal = parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(velWorld)
	local posLocal = posIsLinkLocal and posDelta or parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(posDelta)
	return (velLocal + posLocal) * motionFactor
end

local UpdateCommon = {}
UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta = _posOffsetFrameDelta
UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta

return UpdateCommon

--[[
	UpdateModel Mixin  -  per-frame update for Model particles.
	Same motion branches as UpdatePart; uses :PivotTo for position and :ScaleTo for size.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement so DisplacementMode (Global / Local /
-- RigidLocal) + OnHit mirror axes apply uniformly with the Part / Attachment path
-- in Update.luau:_posOffsetFrameDelta.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	if not (pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs or pData.HasTurbulence) then return Vector3.zero end
	local delta = Vector3.zero
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
		local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
		local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
			pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
		delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	end
	-- Turbulence keeps its own accumulator (_prevTurbOff); see Update.luau twin.
	if pData.HasTurbulence then
		delta = delta + Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	end
	return delta
end

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Model-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes the new pivot via :PivotTo, applies scale + flipbook. Returns true when the
-- particle has died (consumed by Engine.luau's swap-and-pop loop).
function Particle:UpdateModel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		local perStepDT = frameDT / stepsToProcess
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin: angular velocity (deg/sec) into per-axis accumulators.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1
		local spinAddX = pData._spinAccumX or 0
		local spinAddY = pData._spinAccumY or 0
		local spinAddZ = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
		local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping integration across loop iterations.
				displacement = displacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si)

				local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
				local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + spinAddX, rotSpeedY + spinAddY, rotSpeedZ + spinAddZ)
				end

				pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION (accumulated rotation)
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST (absolute rotation)
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotX + spinAddX, rotY + spinAddY, rotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SCALE: ScaleTo cascades to BaseParts, Meshes, PEs, Beams, Trails.
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		local scale = math.max(0.001, pData._staticScale or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale))
		-- Published for nested children's chain (PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor).
		pData._ownScale = scale
		-- Nested Model: compound with the inherited parent-Model scale chain (1 if top-level).
		scale = scale * Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		pData.VisualPart:ScaleTo(scale)
		-- ScaleTo can drop descendant Beam.Segments below 20; re-clamp.
		if pData._visualBeams then
			for _, beam in ipairs(pData._visualBeams) do
				if beam.Parent and beam.Segments < 20 then beam.Segments = 20 end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

--[[
	VisualHost  -  the one place that decides where runtime visuals live.
	Root = workspace.CurrentCamera: Team Create never replicates Camera descendants, so emitted
	clones, pooled clones, previews, screen effects and the distortion canvas stay local to the
	emitting user. A game server has a camera too and nothing under it reaches any player, so
	on a server the root is workspace.Terrain, which replicates; the same without a camera.
	Folders are re-parented, never recreated, when Studio swaps the camera, so live pData
	references stay valid. Anything parented elsewhere is user intent (EmitParent) or an engine
	constraint (Atmosphere renders only under Lighting).
	Carriers: invisible anchored Parts that mirror a user BasePart's CFrame every frame, so
	Attachment / Light visuals that used to live INSIDE the user's part keep parent-relative
	motion without replicating. Engine.step calls VisualHost.tick() before any particle update.
	World carrier: one such Part at the world origin, for an Attachment visual whose source has
	no part above it. Roblox places an Attachment from its nearest ancestor with a place of its
	own, and the Camera is one: an Attachment put straight into a folder under the Camera rides
	the camera. No Attachment visual is ever parented to a runtime folder itself.
	Edit audio host: Studio plays a plugin's Sounds in edit mode only under a DockWidgetPluginGui.
	The plugin registers one (init.server.lua); games never do, so their Sounds stay positional.
]]

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local VisualHost = {}

local LEGACY_ROOT = workspace.Terrain
local FOLDER_NAMES = { live = "EmittedPartsUsingPart_icle", pool = "Part_IclesPooled", preview = "MotionPreview" }

local _folders = {}
local _cameraConn = nil
local _carriers = {}
local _worldCarrier = nil
local _editAudioHost = nil

-- True where the code runs as a server only: a live server, Studio's Run mode and the server
-- side of a play test. Studio edit mode and Team Create editing count as a client.
local function isServerOnly()
	return RunService:IsServer() and not RunService:IsClient()
end

-- The camera for a client or the editor, else Terrain (a server, or no camera); both keep
-- Workspace ancestry so Beams, Trails and BulkMoveTo keep working.
function VisualHost.root()
	if isServerOnly() then return LEGACY_ROOT end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then return cam end
	return LEGACY_ROOT
end

-- Blur / Bloom / ColorCorrection render under the Camera (player-local); Atmosphere is
-- Lighting-only, and so is everything a server emits, for the same reason as root().
function VisualHost.screenEffectParent(kind)
	if kind == "Atmosphere" or isServerOnly() then return Lighting end
	return workspace.CurrentCamera or Lighting
end

local function watchCamera()
	if _cameraConn then return end
	_cameraConn = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		VisualHost.rehome()
	end)
end

-- Move every cached folder under the current root (camera swap). Destroyed folders are dropped
-- so the next accessor rebuilds them.
function VisualHost.rehome()
	local root = VisualHost.root()
	for key, folder in pairs(_folders) do
		if folder.Parent == nil then
			_folders[key] = nil
		elseif folder.Parent ~= root then
			pcall(function() folder.Parent = root end)
		end
	end
end

-- Find-or-create a runtime folder under the root. A folder left under Terrain by an older
-- version (or by a session that died) is adopted and re-parented, so nothing is duplicated.
local function ensureFolder(key)
	local folder = _folders[key]
	if folder and folder.Parent then return folder end
	local name = FOLDER_NAMES[key]
	local root = VisualHost.root()
	folder = root:FindFirstChild(name) or LEGACY_ROOT:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = name
		folder.Archivable = false
	end
	if folder.Parent ~= root then
		pcall(function() folder.Parent = root end)
	end
	_folders[key] = folder
	watchCamera()
	return folder
end

-- Live emit clones.
function VisualHost.getFolder()
	return ensureFolder("live")
end

-- Idle pool entries (Pool.release re-parents here so the Explorer shows what is recyclable).
function VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
	return ensureFolder("pool")
end

-- Motion Preview adornments.
function VisualHost.getPreviewFolder()
	return ensureFolder("preview")
end

-- Distortion canvas parts sit directly under the root.
function VisualHost.getCanvasParent()
	watchCamera()
	return VisualHost.root()
end

-- Set once by the plugin at load (init.server.lua); outlives Activate / Deactivate, so reset() keeps it.
function VisualHost.setEditAudioHost(host)
	_editAudioHost = host
end

-- The plugin's audio widget while it exists; nil in games (Sound emitters then play positionally).
function VisualHost.getEditAudioHost()
	if _editAudioHost and _editAudioHost.Parent then
		return _editAudioHost
	end
	return nil
end

-- Anchor pose: BasePart CFrame or Attachment WorldCFrame.
local function anchorCFrame(anchor)
	if anchor:IsA("Attachment") then return anchor.WorldCFrame end
	return anchor.CFrame
end

-- An invisible anchored Part in `folder` that nothing collides with, finds or saves.
local function newCarrier(name, size, frame, folder)
	local carrier = Instance.new("Part")
	carrier.Name = name
	carrier.Anchored = true
	carrier.CanCollide = false
	carrier.CanQuery = false
	carrier.CanTouch = false
	carrier.CastShadow = false
	carrier.Transparency = 1
	carrier.Size = size
	carrier.CFrame = frame
	carrier.Archivable = false
	carrier:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	carrier.Parent = folder
	return carrier
end

-- Carrier: an invisible anchored Part under the live folder that tracks `anchor` (BasePart or
-- Attachment) each frame. Released by _releaseOrDestroy through releaseCarrier; never pooled.
function VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
	local size = anchor:IsA("BasePart") and anchor.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local carrier = newCarrier("_Carrier", size, anchorCFrame(anchor), VisualHost.getFolder())
	_carriers[carrier] = anchor
	return carrier
end

-- The parent for an Attachment visual with no part to ride: a carrier at the world origin, so
-- the visual's own CFrame is its world frame. Shared by every play and released by none (it is
-- never a pData._carrier); it goes with the live folder and is made again when asked for.
-- EmitAttachment and Container's hostAttachment parent to it in place of the folder.
function VisualHost.worldCarrier()
	local folder = VisualHost.getFolder()
	if _worldCarrier and _worldCarrier.Parent == folder then
		return _worldCarrier
	end
	_worldCarrier = newCarrier("_WorldCarrier", Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame.new(), folder)
	return _worldCarrier
end

function VisualHost.releaseCarrier(carrier)
	if not carrier then return end
	_carriers[carrier] = nil
	pcall(function() carrier:Destroy() end)
end

-- Per-frame mirror. Runs before particle updates so parent-relative math reads this frame's pose.
-- A destroyed anchor freezes its carrier in place (the particle keeps its last parent frame).
function VisualHost.tick()
	if next(_carriers) == nil then return end
	for carrier, anchor in pairs(_carriers) do
		if carrier.Parent == nil then
			_carriers[carrier] = nil
		elseif anchor.Parent ~= nil then
			carrier.CFrame = anchorCFrame(anchor)
		end
	end
end

-- Deactivate: destroy every runtime folder + carrier and stop watching the camera.
function VisualHost.reset()
	if _cameraConn then
		_cameraConn:Disconnect()
		_cameraConn = nil
	end
	for carrier in pairs(_carriers) do
		pcall(function() carrier:Destroy() end)
	end
	table.clear(_carriers)
	_worldCarrier = nil
	for key, folder in pairs(_folders) do
		if folder.Parent then pcall(function() folder:Destroy() end) end
		_folders[key] = nil
	end
	-- Folders a previous version left under Terrain.
	for _, name in pairs(FOLDER_NAMES) do
		local stale = LEGACY_ROOT:FindFirstChild(name)
		if stale then pcall(function() stale:Destroy() end) end
	end
end

return VisualHost

--[[
	ZOffset Mixin  -  per-frame position shift along particle→camera line for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Positive = closer to camera. Runs after Orientation so velocity derivation uses pre-shifted position.
	Moves the visual and never turns it: the rotation it writes is the one the visual has, which
	is what ApplyOrientation wrote this frame (Orientation.luau), or the update's own.
]]

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3

function Particle:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos)
	local zo = pData.ZOffset
	if not zo or zo == 0 then return end
	if not camPos then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	local liveCF = isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame
	-- The shift starts from the pre-overlay base position, so it is absolute; from the live
	-- position it would compound each frame.
	local baseCF = pData._postUpdateCF or liveCF

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; convert to world for the camera shift, back to local on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			baseCF = parentPart.CFrame * baseCF
			liveCF = parentPart.CFrame * liveCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = baseCF.Position
	local toCam = camPos - pos
	local mag = toCam.Magnitude
	if mag < EPS then return end
	local newPos = pos + (toCam / mag) * zo
	local newCF = CFrame.new(newPos) * liveCF.Rotation

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end
